virtio.allocator: kernel/src/main.rs init_block_and_fat: PMM alloc_frames(4), alloc_frame(); HHDM identity of frames retained
virtio.caller_memory: never device-accessible; writes copied into request bounce page, successful reads copied out
virtio.created: PMM frames permanently allocated before init
virtio.prepared: CPU writes header/data/status and descriptor chain
virtio.submitted: avail.idx publication with SeqCst fences then queue notify; device may access queue/request
virtio.completed: exact next used.idx and head 0, CPU fence then status; valid completion releases request for serialized reuse
virtio.timed_out_uncertain: latch uncertain=true, retain pages and descriptors, all later requests rejected
virtio.retired: no DMA unmap/free; kernel keeps allocations for lifetime, drop does not stop DMA
virtio.request_identity: single head 0 with exact used-index progression; after uncertainty no slot reuse at all; no reusable request generations
virtio.late_completion: may update retained old pages; cannot be accepted for a fresh request after quarantine
virtio.duplicate: unexpected index before submit or invalid delta/head after submit poisons queue; malicious future DMA not prevented
limitations: no actual device late-completion fault execution
fixed queue size lacks allocation-fit validation

usb.allocator: kernel/src/usb_storage.rs PMM DMA_PAGES, pinned for kernel lifetime even rejected probe
usb.owner: kernel/src/usb_xhci.rs Controller, private staging buffers; BOT caller stack never directly DMA mapped
usb.completion: event slot, endpoint and TRB pointer; actual length/residue checked before copy
usb.timeout: dead=true; reset/clear_halt/bulk return Offline; allocation retained
usb.fence: controller halt/recovery paths exist but no SFS5A authoritative fencing execution
